## Services
1. Spatial Strategy - Starting at $1,500
   - How your space needs to operate
   - Flow, zoning, team movement, conversion points
   
2. Concept and Direction - Starting at $2,500
   - Concrete direction for your buildout
   - Before/after planning, visual concepts
   
3. Implementation Support - $150/hour
   - Guidance through construction phase
   - Contractor coordination, floor plan review

## Key Value Proposition
Josh Pelham provides 1-on-1 direct consultation throughout every phase of spatial projects. Not just design thinking, but business-focused spatial strategy that drives customer flow, conversion, and operational efficiency.

## FAQs
Q: Do you provide drawings I can give to my contractor?
A: We provide spatial strategy, concepts, and direction. We work with contractors to develop drawings as part of implementation.

Q: How long does a typical project take?
A: Spatial Strategy takes 2-3 weeks. Concept and Direction 4-6 weeks depending on scope.

Q: Can you work with my existing contractor or architect?
A: Yes. We coordinate with your team to ensure spatial logic is built into the final design.

Q: Do you work remotely?
A: Yes. We serve clients throughout the region and beyond.
